title: Response training and coordinated exercises need dated deployment evidence
remediation: The deployment incident response lead assigns role-specific training and exercise cadence, then coordinates a representative drill with continuity, privacy and other applicable plan owners. Retain attendance, scope, scenario, measured performance, corrective actions and follow-up retest. Use supplier drills only for the exercised component and event.

milestones.title: Collect training history, approved scenario and coordination records, exercise results and retested corrective actions
